2022_245_feb_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) activity report for February 2022, printed 4/14/2022 and carried on the Board of Education agenda for the meeting of April 19, 2022. The thirty-page listing itemizes every card transaction by posting date and truncated merchant name, all coded to the journal entry description "FEB PCARD EXP," with a 15-digit budget unit and a four-digit account code for each line. The report closes with a subtotal of $301,321.11 in transaction amounts against $3,991.48 in credits, and total expenses of $297,329.63.
